tei:div.tei:p: // dril bu lus dkyil shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil la rgyun 'khyer bya bar 'dod pa dag dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ rdor dril/ nang mchod/ sa gtor sogs nyer mkho 'du byas te/ stan bde bar 'dug la/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom pa gsal bar gyur/ nang mchod khaṇḍa ro hes bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me nas/ gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ spro na sngon gtor yang dril zhabs zhal lung ltar bya/ yang na/ a mṛ ta lcer bzhag pas kha dag par byas la/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyang dril zhabs zhal lung ltar bya/ srung 'khor dang tshogs zhing ni/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ā/ nas/ ha kṣaḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dbyangs gsal dang*| rdo rje'i ra gur/ mda'i dra ba/ bla bre dang bcas pa 'jigs dus kyi me ltar 'bar bas phyogs bcur khyab cing me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su rang nyid he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po'i 'od kyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpal he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying gar thim par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ ā tsa mā naṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ= pā dyaṃ= zhes chu bzhi dang*/ oṃ badzra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs nas/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar sngags rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// nas/ go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgyi'i bar gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom mo// swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la hūm̐ baṃ dmar mthing yongs su gyur pa las/

bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing nag /sngo/ ljang*/ dmar/ ser ba'i zhal bzhi spyan bcu gnyis pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can la sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla phyed kyis spras pa/ thod skam lnga rdo rjes sbrel ba'i dbu rgyan can zhal mche ba bcu drug cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis glang lpags/ g.yas lhag ma bzhi ḍā ru/ dgra sta/ gri gug /rtse gsum/ g.yon lhag ma bzhi kha ṭwāṃ/ thod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris dang mgo phreng gis brgyan cing phyag rgya drug gis mtshan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskums pas bzhengs pa'i pang du bcom ldan 'das ma skra grol spyan gsum mnga' zhing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thogs nas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod pa'i dum bus spras shing phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can thabs shes gnyis su med par sbyor ba'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa rlung*/ sum mdo gru gsum me/ lte ba zlum po chu/ brang gru bzhi sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal med khang*/ rlung lnga rtsig pa sogs lus dkyil gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dbus dhū tir 'jigs dus kyi gdan la dkar cha hūm̐ dang*/ dmar cha baṃ las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das mthing nag ces pa nas/ gnyis su med par sbyor ba'i bar gong ltar dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba bzhi g.yon skor du māṃ tāṃ pāṃ lāṃ las mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga /lā ma ljang gu/ dum skyes ma dmar mo/ gzugs can ma ser mo bzhi ga'ang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa kha ṭwāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon du thogs pa/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa bzhi bum thod bdud rtsis gang ba'o// spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir/

pū dzā o a gau ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka laṃ ka hi/ pre gṛ sau su nā si ma ku rnams las gnas rnams sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo dkar dmar mthing ga rtsa rnams dpa' mo dang*/ nang du 'bab pa'i khams rnams dpa' bor gyur pa ni/ spyi bor thod dum dang rab gtum ma/ spyi gtsug tu keng rus dang gtum mig ma/ rna g.yas kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag par mche ba rnam gtsigs dang sna chen ma ste gnas so// rna g.yon su ra bai ri dang dpa' mo'i blo can ma| smin mtshams 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig tu rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis su rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma rnams nye gnas te/ thugs 'khor thams cad sngo bsangs mkha' spyod/ mchan 'og gnyis su myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ nu ma rdo rje ral can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo*// lte bar dpal chen dang rlung shugs ma/ sna rtser rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye zhing*/ khar rab bzang dang sngo bsangs lha mo/ mgrin par rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshandho ha/ snying gar 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ 'doms bar du mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste nye ba'i tshandho ha/ gsung 'khor rnams thams cad dmar po sa spyod/ mtshan mar stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma ste 'du ba/ brla gnyis su rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ byin pa gnyis su nam snying dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug tu he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis su padma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhir rnam snang dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis su rdor sems dang brtson chen ma ste nye ba'i dur khrod/ sku 'khor rnams dkar po/ de ltar dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig /spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/

mi mgo'i do shal dang stag sham dang ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang gar gyi nyams dgu phyag rgya drug gis mtshan pa g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs can/ yum rnams gri thod 'dzin cing phyag rgya lnga sogs bcom ldan 'das ma lta bu byin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ snying ga'i phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad hūm̐ ring po brgyad dang gnyis su med pa las/ shar du kha gdong ma sngon mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ mer brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ srin por pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ rlung du mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan du 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo rnams ro gdan la g.yas brkyangs pas gnas pa zhal gcig /spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha thams cad bcom ldan 'das la zhal phyogs pa'o// zhes bskyed/ dag pa dran cing nga rgyal ni// yab yum gnyis su med pa nyid kyi lha so bdun du gnas pa ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun te gdod ma nas rang nyid la yongs su grub bo/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ 'dzam bu gling du bzhugs pa'i sprul pa rnams dang*/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs sku rnams dang*/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i lha rnams rnam gsum dbyer med thabs shes gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du dag pa nga'o// oṃ badzra shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ go cha ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing ga /bcom ldan 'das sogs dpa' bo thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgrin par na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/

phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ rnal 'byor ma sogs dpa' mo rnams dang sgo mtshams ma bcas pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ 'bar ba'i rgya g.yon du smin mtshams su bskor ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa thams cad dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ chu bzhi dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag cing bdag kyang de'i ngor dag go// zhes bsgom/ ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams bzhugs pa la/ chu bzhi dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ dpa' mo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa yum lngas rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa las bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ rnal 'byor ma la rnam snang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor rnams la mi bskyod pa/

gsung 'khor rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor rnams la rnam snang*/ phyogs mtshams ma brgyad la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod bstod ni/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros nas 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams mchod par gyur par dmigs la/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rang gis bdud rtsi myangs pas 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams tshim par bsam zhing myang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ| zhes rjes chags dang*/ mthar de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis dril zhabs zhal lung ltar bstod/ bskyed rim gyis ngal na bzlas pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi lte ba dang snying gar phag mo'i snying po dang nye snying*/ mgrin pa dang dpral bar rang gi snying po dang nye snying*/ bcom ldan 'das ma la de las ldog par gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng zhal nas thon yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi mkha' nas yab kyi gsang bar zhugs te 'khor zhing 'khor bar gyur par dmigs la/ rus chen gyi phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nye snying ngo*// oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yum gyi snying po dang nye snying ngo*// de dag ji srid mi skyo'i bar bzla'o// de nas thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ gtso bo yab yum 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams so so'i gnas su thim/ rang nyid phyi'i he ru ka zhal phyag yongs rdzogs sam lhan skyes su gsal bar gyur par dmigs/ go chas bsrungs te spyod lam la 'jug cing slar sngar ltar gsal btab bo// thun mtshams su 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das gnyis kyi gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/

smon lam gdab pa sogs yan lag gi rnal 'byor rnams dang*/ spros pa la dga' bas cho ga'i yan lag zhib cha rnams ni kho bos bgyis pa'i dril zhabs zhal lung du rtogs par bya'o// de ltar dril bu lus dkyil shin tu bsdus pa 'di'ang blo dman rnams kyi don du/ 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas pho brang bde ba can du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
